description: Dry-run TWAP planner: splits a swap into N slices every intervalSeconds and compares with one swap now (impact per slice, estimated gain in bps, schedule with min-out per slice). Never sends anything; build each slice with blazar_build_swap when it is due. Polygon only (chain 137).

amount.description: Amount of tokenIn in HUMAN units, not wei: "1.5" = 1.5 POL, "250" = 250 BZB. Set amountIsBaseUnits=true to pass wei/base units instead.

amountIsBaseUnits.description: If true, amount is in base units (wei for 18-decimal tokens; 6 decimals for USDC). Default false.

tokenIn.description: Token to sell: symbol (POL, WPOL, BZB, USDC, USDT, WETH, WBTC) or its listed 0x address (see blazar_tokens). "POL" is the native gas token; WPOL is the ERC-20.

tokenOut.description: Token to buy: symbol (POL, WPOL, BZB, USDC, USDT, WETH, WBTC) or its listed 0x address. Choose "POL" to receive native POL (auto-unwrapped).

name: blazar_plan_twap
title: TWAP plan (dry run)
